newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.56 rgt.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.56 rgt.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia closed unchanged at 14.56 ringgit ($5.77) a kg after sellers and buyers decided to close deals at the opening level, traders said.
They saw an opening offer of 108 tonnes against bid at 97. Final volume was 100 tonnes against 97 on Wednesday.
"The market is holding steady despite a small fall in London prices," a trader said.
The local price differential to London was $105 a tonne premium against $100 previously. --Tan Lee Lee (603-230-8911) ($1=2.5245 ringgit)
